title: Product Allowance and Overage Charging on Office Pantry & Beverage Program Sites
content:
Product delivered in a billing period is measured against the monthly product allowance printed against the tier, product group by product group. Consumption inside the grace share printed against the tier is absorbed without charge; consumption beyond that grace is charged at landed cost plus the overage markup printed against the same tier. These terms apply to every Office Pantry & Beverage Program tier.

## The overage for a billing period

1. The grace ceiling for the period is the monthly product allowance printed against the tier increased by the grace share printed against the same tier, rounded to two decimal places. The grace share is stated as a percentage of the allowance.
2. Where the product value delivered in the period stands at or below that grace ceiling, no overage is charged.
3. Where it stands above the grace ceiling, the overage charged is the amount by which the delivered value exceeds the grace ceiling, increased by the overage markup printed against the tier, rounded to two decimal places.

Worked on hypothetical figures: a hypothetical monthly allowance of 1000.00, a hypothetical grace share of 5.00 percent and a hypothetical markup of 15.00 percent. The grace ceiling stands at 1050.00. A period in which product to the value of 1200.00 was delivered exceeds that ceiling by 150.00, and the overage charged is that 150.00 increased by the markup, which is 172.50. A period in which product to the value of 1050.00 was delivered stands at the ceiling and carries no overage.

Consumption in a period may also be read as a proportion: the product value delivered in the period named on the invoice, divided by the monthly product allowance, expressed as a percentage.

## Periods, pauses and the allowance itself

4. The allowance is not carried forward: a light month does not build credit for a heavy one, and a heavy month is charged in the period it falls in.
5. Where the client asks to raise the allowance, the programme is moved to the tier whose allowance covers their consumption rather than the allowance being varied on the tier in force.
6. Product taken during a pause is impossible, since no deliveries are made, so a paused month produces no overage whatever the site consumed from stock already on the shelf.

## Consumption review

A consumption review is held at the frequency printed against the tier, and a client whose consumption has run above the allowance for three periods running is offered the next tier up.
